Hi Mr Hadley,

Thank you for getting in touch about the renewal. We have really enjoyed living here over the past three years and would love to stay on for another year.

We completely understand that your costs and mortgage have gone up. At the same time, £1,450 is a difficult jump from £1,250 in one go with our own household costs rising too.

Since we have always paid on time over the last three years and renewing with us avoids any void period or reletting costs, would you consider £1,350 a month for the next 12 months?

Please let us know what you think.

Please let me know if either of those options could work for you and the board—I'd be very glad to help you get the best result within your budget.

Thank you for your offer and for your kind words about 14 Larch Road—we are really glad to hear you love the house. Being chain-free first-time buyers puts you in a great position, and since we have no onward chain on our side either, we could move forward smoothly and quickly.

Unfortunately, £378,000 is too far below our £415,000 asking price for us to accept, particularly given the new kitchen installed in 2023 and the south-facing garden. However, because we value having strong, chain-free buyers, we are willing to come down from our asking price and would be open to discussing an offer around £395,000 if you have any flexibility to bridge the gap.

Please let us know if you are able to stretch any further—we would love to find a figure that works for both of us.
